Email Signature Maker

Fill in your details, change the photo if you need to, then copy the signature into Outlook. The signature is one picture, so it fits any screen and looks right in dark mode.

Use a wide photo for best results. After uploading, drag the photo in the preview, or use the sliders, to choose what shows.

  1. Click Copy signature for Outlook.
  2. In Outlook, open Settings, then Account, then Signatures, and open your signature.
  3. Delete the old signature in the box, press Cmd+V (Ctrl+V on Windows), and click Save.
